bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd "$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
branch="fix/gay-video-pin-stale-message-repair-20261123"
expected="e957518b3d3dea5959e3d86db1d4298b99a3bac2"
worktree="$PWD/.worktrees/video-two-pin-20261124"
git fetch --no-tags origin "$branch" >/dev/null
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$expected" || exit 51
mkdir -p .worktrees
if ! test -d "$worktree"; then git worktree add --detach "$worktree" "$expected" >/dev/null; fi
test "$(git -C "$worktree" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$expected" || exit 52
test -z "$(git -C "$worktree" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 53
docker build --quiet -f "$worktree/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-gay-pin-repair:20261124 "$worktree" >/dev/null
cid="$(docker create --entrypoint sh gace-gay-pin-repair:20261124 -c true)"
trap 'docker rm -f "$cid" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
mkdir -p "$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-pin-20261124"
docker cp "$cid:/app/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" "$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-pin-20261124/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs"
node --check "$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-pin-20261124/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" || exit 54
grep -q VIDEO_TWO_TOPIC_RECOVER_GAY_ONLY "$PWD/deploy/state/video-two-pin-20261124/repairTwoVideoChatPinnedEntries.mjs" || exit 55
echo "GAY_PIN_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_STAGED=PASS"
